caption: I sell funeral policies for a living and the app still found R1 380 a month leaking out of my own account on things I'd forgotten I was paying for. What's hiding in yours?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R26 800
p/m salary
Living in Welkom
slides.body:
Female, 34
Single, no kids
Job: Funeral parlour administrator
Net salary: R26 800 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.body: Quiet street, five minutes from the parlour. I need the quiet after some of the days I have.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Shoprite, and the top-ups I do not plan for
slides.body: I cook properly maybe three nights a week. The rest is whatever's fastest.

slides.title: Car instalment
slides.body: The most boring line on this list, and the one that never surprises me.

slides.title: Forgotten subscriptions & debit orders
slides.includes: An insurance add-on from 2019, doubled cellphone insurance, a subscription box I never cancelled
slides.body: I thought this was maybe R400. It's R1 380. I found the doubled insurance by accident.

slides.title: Funeral policy
slides.includes: My own family's cover, staff rate and all
slides.body: I sell this exact product all day and still pay close to full price for my own.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Petrol & insurance, medical aid, phone & data, electricity, stokvel, savings
slides.body: R12 200 that isn't rent and isn't debt. It's the only part of this I can actually move.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R26 800. The leaks alone were most of the difference between a tight month and a fine one.

slides.title: The leaks were the real story
slides.body:
Beyond Horizon flagged three debit orders I didn't recognise the first week I uploaded a statement.

One was doubled cellphone insurance I'd been paying since 2019.

No bank login needed.
